title: urlSync bug with base attribute
body:
Hello,

There is a bug happening when `urlSync: true` and the html page has a `base` attribute which is different from the current URL. It will instantly replace the URL with the `base` url, to which is appended the instantsearch.js state as a query string

Demo: http://url-syncbug.surge.sh/test

The base attribute is:

```html
<base href="http://url-syncbug.surge.sh">
```

The page URL is instantly changed to http://url-syncbug.surge.sh/?q=rake\&hPP=6\&idx=Version\_development\&p=0\&is\_v=1

One solution could be to replace the entire URI path instead of just the query params part
